items.description: A result uses the wrong substrate, product, stereochemical mapping, protonation, charge/spin, reference state or unbalanced particle ledger. Invalidate affected scientific comparisons; do not transfer agreement from another species.

Paper values, fabricated outputs, unexecuted work, unsupported stationary-point labels or platform success alone are represented as computed evidence. Such results earn no scientific credit; assess the independent process axis separately.

An unsupported extrapolation is used as proof of kinetics, selectivity or a unique mechanism beyond the computed states and conditions. Invalidate that inference rather than treating a plausible narrative as a resolved result.
